_doc: Dimwit pluggable GEOMETRY backends — closes G3 (single paid-cloud dependency). Dimwit picks a geometry source by name; the character/generation pipelines resolve it via dimwit/geometry_backends.py. status: BUILT (runnable now) | SCAFFOLD (adapter + exact activation contract). The 'primitive' backend is the GUARANTEED LOCAL FALLBACK so the engine never hard-stops when Hi3D is unavailable. Provenance fail-closed: every backend records source+license before any asset it makes can promote.

hi3d.does: Highest-fidelity image->3D (the current primary). ~2M-tri detailed mesh.

triposr.does: Local single-image->3D on the RTX 3070 — removes the network/credits dependency.
triposr.integration: dimwit/neural3d.py isolated venv; infer -> mesh -> handcraft topology pipeline.
triposr.activate: pip install in the neural3d venv: torch + tsr; download the TripoSR weights; set neural3d.ENABLED=1.

instantmesh.does: Multi-view local image->3D (higher fidelity than TripoSR when a GPU is free).
instantmesh.integration: isolated venv; multiview -> mesh -> handcraft. Research the active repo + weights license first.

primitive.does: GUARANTEED FALLBACK: deterministic correctly-proportioned humanoid blockout (clean quads, manifold, UV'd) at SK_Mannequin scale. Honest PLACEHOLDER (not promotable) that keeps the whole pipeline runnable + riggable OFFLINE when every other backend is unavailable.
